# thousandeyes_stream (Resource)

Retrieve data stream.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Flag to enable or disable the stream integration.
- `endpoint_agent_label` (Attributes Set) A collection of Endpoint Agent label IDs that determines what local network data is included in the data stream. `endpointAgentLabel` and `endpointAgentTag` represent the same data. Configure only one; both are synchronized. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoint_agent_label))
- `endpoint_agent_tag` (Attributes Set) A collection of Endpoint Agent Tag IDs that determines what local network data is included in the data stream. `endpointAgentLabel` and `endpointAgentTag` represent the same data. Configure only one; both are synchronized. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoint_agent_tag))
- `exporter_config` (Attributes) Capability to set exporter configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exporter_config))
- `filters` (Attributes) Provides the ability to filter data points based on the specified test types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `input_config` (Attributes) Configuration that specifies which input data is included for each signal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--input_config))
- `stream_endpoint_url` (String) The URL ThousandEyes sends data stream to. For a URL to be valid, it needs to: - Be syntactically correct. - Be reachable. - Use the HTTPS protocol. - When using the `grpc` endpointType, streamEndpointUrl cannot contain paths: - Valid . `grpc` - `https://example.com` - Invalid . `grpc` - `https://example.com/collector`. - Valid . `http` - `https://example.com/collector`. - When using the `http` endpointType, the operation must match the exact final full URL (including the path if there is one) to which the data will be sent. Examples below: - `https://api.honeycomb.io:443/v1/metrics` - `https://ingest.eu0.signalfx.com/v2/datapoint/otlp`
- `tag_match` (Attributes Set) A collection of tags that determine what tests are included in the data stream. These tag values are also included as attributes in the data stream metrics. Tags are invalid if the tag key includes characters that are not allowed by the [OpenTelemetry naming recommendations for attributes](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/naming/#recommendations-for-application-developers). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tag_match))
- `test_match` (Attributes Set) A collection of tests to be included in the data stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--test_match))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The data stream ID
- `stream_status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stream_status))

<a id="nestedatt--stream_status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stream_status`

Read-Only:

- `last_failure` (Number) Last timestamp when data failed to send the stream endpoint.
- `last_success` (Number) Last timestamp when data was successfully sent to the stream endpoint.
- `status` (String) The status of the stream integration. pending: No data is currently being sent to the stream endpoint. failing: Data is being sent but not successfully reaching the stream endpoint. connected: Data is being sent successfully to the stream endpoint.
